# Pull Request Checklist

Quantum Foundry is an independent personal project and is not an official Google product.

- [ ] No wording implies this is an official Google product.
- [ ] Independent-project disclaimer preserved.
- [ ] Hardware-access disclaimer preserved where relevant.
- [ ] Docs updated.
- [ ] Tests run.
- [ ] No secrets committed.
- [ ] No non-Google quantum SDK added as a primary path.
- [ ] No quantum advantage claim added without source and qualification.
- [ ] License and NOTICE remain accurate for changed files or new third-party dependencies.
